verdict.rationale: Rippling documents its own custom workflow builder that automates administrative tasks, such as triggering a reminder to pay a bonus or a Slack alert from a Zendesk ticket. It also lets payroll run on a schedule you choose, which implies some time-based execution, but nothing explicitly documents defining recurring or cron-style scheduled workflows. Missing for 10: explicit recurring or scheduled workflow triggers, schedule configuration documentation, API/CLI control of scheduled jobs, hands-on corroboration.
